name: 12110 · Latham, NY
findings: ZIP 12110 (Latham) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12110 (Latham) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
